title: Go SDK: ergonomic typed models + generic streaming decoders
creator: Anita Patel
body:
Background:
We get frequent asks from SDK consumers for a) first-class typed decoding of structured model output into Go structs, b) an ergonomic streaming API that yields typed values rather than raw byte events, and c) well-specified helpers for safe retries / partial-results handling when streams fail. Existing helpers are ad-hoc (Decode* helpers and streaming examples) and put too much burden on caller error-handling and backpressure semantics.

Goal:
Build a small, well-documented package (redwood/sdkgo/typeddecode) that provides: 1) generics-based streaming decoders (DecodeStream[T]) that decode newline-delimited JSON / SSE into typed T values; 2) utilities for partial-object decoding and graceful degradation (e.g., DecodeOptionalFields, FallbackDecoder); 3) a lightweight codegen helper (go gen tool) that can emit Go struct types from the model schema used in our model registry so examples are copy/paste ready; 4) explicit retry semantics for streaming endpoints (resume tokens, idempotency token propagation, opt-in retry-on-stream-error).

Design notes / API sketch:
- func DecodeStream[T any](r io.Reader, onValue func(T) error, opts ...StreamOpt) error
  - Decodes JSON objects separated by newline or SSE event boundaries (support both) and calls onValue for each successfully decoded T.
  - onValue can return ErrStopStream to stop early.
  - StreamOpt includes MaxBuffered, BackpressureTimeout, AllowPartial (bool), and Logger.

- Convenience wrapper: func StreamAsChannel[T any](ctx context.Context, client *Client, req Request) (<-chan T, <-chan error)
  - Internally uses DecodeStream[T] + a bounded channel to provide idiomatic Go usage. Cancellation closes channels.

- Retry semantics:
  - New client option RetryConfig{MaxAttempts, Backoff, RetryOnStreamError bool, ResumeHeader string}.
  - For non-idempotent endpoints we keep default RetryOnStreamError=false.
  - For streaming append/continuation we support a ResumeHeader (e.g., X-Redwood-Stream-Resume-Token) – model server can return tokens in the last event so client can request resumption.

- Codegen helper:
  - A small command redwood-gen-go that reads a JSON schema (from model registry artifact) and emits go structs with json tags and pointer/nullable handling. Developers can run `go generate ./...` to produce examples under examples/typed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Package typeddecode implemented and exported with tests covering: normal stream decode, partial-field decode with AllowPartial, backpressure behavior (bounded channel), and early stop.
- StreamAsChannel helper implemented and documented with example in examples/structured_streaming/main.go that shows decoding a CompletionResult struct.
- RetryConfig implemented and client honors RetryOnStreamError flag; at minimum a unit test simulating an intermittent server disconnect and verifying behavior for both true/false.
- Codegen tool implements 80% common cases for model schema -> Go structs (strings, ints, floats, nested objects, arrays) and produces example files in /examples/generated_types.
- PR with docs (README + godoc) and a short migration note for callers that currently decode raw events.

Testing strategy:
- Unit tests for typeddecode that feed synthetic readers (strings.NewReader) including malformed lines to verify AllowPartial semantics.
- Integration test using local mock server (httptest.Server) that streams SSE/newline-delimited JSON and intentionally drops connection to exercise RetryOnStreamError and resume behavior.
- Load test for backpressure: spawn N goroutines calling StreamAsChannel and ensure memory boundedness with channel buffer limits.

Risks and trade-offs:
- Generics-based API requires Go 1.19+; SDK already pins to Go 1.20 in CI so OK.
- Resume tokens require server-side support. We'll ship client-side knobs first and follow up with server resume support in the model-serving backlog.
- Codegen edges (union types, oneOf) will be intentionally conservative: generate `json.RawMessage` fields with TODO comments for manual fixups.

Notes for maintainers:
- Keep the core decoder deliberately small; advanced validation should live in a separate package (typedvalidate).
- Avoid changing existing Client.Stream() signature; add StreamTyped[T] helpers to preserve backwards compatibility.

Examples (to include in README):

1) Simple typed streaming example:

    type CompletionResult struct {
        Id   string `json:"id"`
        Text string `json:"text"`
    }

    ch, errs := StreamAsChannel[CompletionResult](ctx, client, req)
    for {
        select {
        case v, ok := <-ch:
            if !ok { ch = nil; continue }
            fmt.Println("got ->", v.Text)
        case e := <-errs:
            if e != nil { log.Fatal(e) }
        case <-ctx.Done():
            return ctx.Err()
        }
        if ch == nil { break }
    }

2) DecodeStream usage with onValue callback and partial allow:

    err := DecodeStream[CompletionResult](resp.Body, func(r CompletionResult) error {
        // process; may return ErrStopStream to cancel early
        return nil
    }, AllowPartial(true))
comments: 2026-02-21 - Marco: initial spike implemented a prototype DecodeStream in a feature branch. Working demo with newline-delimited objects produced by mock server.
2026-02-25 - Anita: design review notes - agree on BackpressureTimeout and opt-in AllowPartial. Asked to add StreamAsChannel convenience wrapper for ergonomics.
2026-03-01 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/512 (prototype decoder + tests) - needs unit test coverage and docs.
2026-03-05 - Codegen alpha pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/520 - emits basic structs and documented caveats for union/oneOf.
2026-03-10 - Review feedback (Sofia Chen): ensure RetryOnStreamError default is false and add explicit example showing resume token flow. Added acceptance criteria test for both retry modes.
2026-03-13 - Marco: updated StreamAsChannel to close error channel after data channel is closed to avoid leaks; added integration test using httptest.Server that simulates mid-stream disconnects.
acceptance_criteria: typeddecode package exported with DecodeStream[T], StreamAsChannel[T] and unit tests
documentation + README with examples included in SDK repo
RetryConfig respected by client and covered by integration test
codegen emits example types under examples/generated_types and run via go generate
